description: Build a link that opens RewindMap's short-video maker preloaded with a map clip: borders (and optional event layers) changing from one year to another over a place, with an optional title and map labels. The visitor opens the link and taps Download to get a watermarked MP4 (vertical 9:16 for Shorts/Reels/TikTok, or landscape). Rendering happens in the visitor's browser; this tool returns the link only, never a video file.

bbox.description: Area to frame [west, south, east, north] in degrees. Default: Europe and the Mediterranean.

from_year.description: Year. Negative is BC: -500 = 500 BC. There is no year 0.

labels.description: Map labels drawn at fixed points in every frame.

title.description: Text burned into the top of the video.

to_year.description: Year. Negative is BC: -500 = 500 BC. There is no year 0.

name: create_video_link
